name: Diff
summary: The diff of whichever change is selected on the canvas, file by file.
guidance: The actual diff of the selected change is on this kehikko, so read it before saying anything about that change. A title, a description and a commit message are all claims about a diff; this is the diff. If they disagree, the diff is what happened and the disagreement is itself worth reporting. The selection is the scope: review what is selected rather than the whole branch, and if a file in it looks wrong for reasons outside the selection, write that down instead of widening what you touch. The canvas may point at a line of the change (context.location); set one to show the person a line here and in Source.
partless: Shows the one change a person selected, which is always in hand.
